reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for reading PDF text page by page and applying OCR to scanned or image-heavy pages, with configurable limits, engines, and caching.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中按页读取 PDF 文本，并对扫描页或图片页进行 OCR 识别的文档处理插件。
summaries.en: A document-processing plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reads PDF text page by page and applies OCR to scanned or image-heavy pages.

capabilities: Reads PDF files from local paths
Extracts Unicode text from PDF pages
Uses Windows OCR through powershell.exe or optional tesseract.js
Stores temporary OCR data and cached results
